name: Vizal no Nikki
source:
A harbor city at the southern tip of the continent: the autonomous region of Saint South. The west side street - full of street merchants lined up next to each other. When heading into one of the street alleys, the lively bustling of taverns and inns isn't far.

Should you live in this area, you'll get used to the noise rather quickly. The usual sight of Vizal's office in a corner of a back street - unremarkable, peaceful and tranquil.

One day, a big wooden crate gets delivered to the office. Inside, there is a puppet carved out of wood. The puppet then speaks to Vizal:

"Hey, youngster, what are you doing?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056683.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
大陆南端的一座港口城市：圣南自治区。西侧的街道上，满是鳞次栉比的街头商贩。走进一条小巷，不远处就是熙熙攘攘的小酒馆和客栈。

如果你住在这个地区，你很快就会习惯噪音。维扎尔办公室位于后街一角的常见景象——不起眼、平和、宁静。

有一天，一个大木箱被送到办公室。里面有一个木头雕刻的木偶。然后木偶对维扎尔说话：

“嘿，年轻人，你在做什么？”
